category_edits.rationale: Use bounded sigmoid gating in every HSTU attention block across all four category models to reduce extreme gate amplification. Preserve projections, attention, residual paths, FFN, embeddings, readout, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports HSTURec from train.py, so it automatically uses the identical updated architecture with unchanged checkpoint shapes.

response.change_summary: Replace SiLU attention gating with sigmoid gating for all four independent HSTU category models and enforce the required data-directory environment variable.
